statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry is clinically indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to the symptomatic episodes
This diagnostic procedure is medically necessary to assess the cause of the patient's recurrent dizziness in the context of established coronary artery disease and mitral valve insufficiency
